concerns.text: T005 and T006 consume code directories `data/validated/human/` and `data/validated/llm/`, but no prior task creates or populates these directories. The pipeline lacks a producer step that materialises the validated code samples (e.g., writing each validated snippet to the appropriate directory) after T004. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer ordering rule and makes US2 not independently shippable.
